description: Extract candidate-produced archives into a shared output directory.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: Candidate vectors are maintained as a population.; fitness_evaluation: fitness sums candidate genes.; selection: The candidates are sorted and a selected half is processed.; mutation: Each copied child receives a gene increment.; replacement: The function returns selected candidates and mutated offspring together.. Negative-role rationale: Only copied single-parent children are generated, and the source contains no generation-level termination condition. Safety behavior: The EA extracts each supplied archive into a shared destination with extractall and no member-path validation. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
